description.name: PhonePe Payment Gateway
description.tagline: India's leading UPI & digital payments platform — developed by SkyServer Cloud Technologies.
description.long: Accept payments from your customers via PhonePe — India's most trusted digital payments platform used by 500M+ users. Supports UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking and Wallets. This module is developed and maintained by SkyServer Cloud Technologies.
features: UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking & Wallet payments
Secure SHA256 checksum verification on every transaction
Automatic payment status update in WHMCS on success
